days.title: Ducal Residences and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Casinetto
stops.detail: He added a very long colonnade with the Casinetto at the center, a building with a clock and bell tower, which housed the court theater.

stops.name: Villa del Ferlaro
stops.detail: The Villa del Ferlaro was built by Duchess Maria Luisa of Austria on a pre-existing building, the Casinetto Fedolfi, to serve as a summer residence for her children.

days.title: Nature and Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bosco della Capannella
stops.detail: The Bosco della Capannella is a suggestive area of the park that runs alongside the municipal road connecting Sala Baganza to Collecchio, known as the "strada del Conventino".

stops.name: lago delle Navette
stops.detail: Among the reptiles, the pond turtle is frequent, inhabiting the lakes (in particular Lake Navette and Lake Svizzera) and pools.

stops.name: lago della Vigna
stops.detail: The main ones are Lake Vigna (approx. 18,000 m2), Lake Svizzera, Lake Grotta, Lake Navetta, Lake Pini, and Lake Ponte Verde.
